title: Artifact detail UI regression fixes and implementation-language cleanup
observed_behavior: Light-mode code blocks can inherit dark text on gray code backgrounds.
Artifact detail cards duplicate artifact name and version when only image_tag is available.
Artifact detail back navigation and page title can appear as a single visual group instead of the stacked detail-page pattern.
Artifact detail cards use inconsistent large value text, causing clipping and overflow.
The version card uses the unknown/question-mark icon.
Long artifact and metadata identifiers can overflow detail containers.
The artifact SBOM tab calls unsupported artifact SBOM REST endpoints from the browser.
The signature verification button and some auth/DNS copy expose implementation details such as ContextVM and protocol numbers.
intended_behavior: Code blocks remain readable in light and dark themes.
Artifact overview cards display distinct product fields without duplicating name as version.
Artifact detail navigation, headings, cards, and identifiers remain visually consistent and bounded.
Artifact SBOM content renders from the artifact read model/projection without calling unsupported endpoints.
High-visibility user-facing copy uses product language while implementation constants remain internal.
out_of_scope: Full admin/settings terminology redesign for relay/operator-only panels.
